description: This file defines the ValidatorActionFilter class, which implements ASP.NET Core's IActionFilter to validate API request models and return JSON-formatted error responses when validation fails.

classes.name: ValidatorActionFilter
classes.description: A filter that intercepts action executions to validate model state and return error details in JSON format if validation fails.

methods.name: OnActionExecuting
methods.description: Checks model state validity before the action executes and returns a JSON error response with status code 422 if invalid.

methods.name: OnActionExecuted
methods.description: Empty implementation, required by IActionFilter interface, executes after the action method.
